name: Martin Vechev

affiliations.role: Professor and head of the lab (ETH Zurich)

bio: Martin Vechev is a professor of computer science at ETH Zurich, where Vechev heads the Secure, Reliable, and Intelligent Systems (SRI) Lab, and the founder and scientific director of INSAIT in Sofia, Bulgaria. INSAIT, set up with ETH Zurich and EPFL, released the BgGPT family of Bulgarian language models. Vechev also co-founded the companies LatticeFlow, DeepCode and ChainSecurity.
known_for: Founder and scientific director of INSAIT
Head of ETH Zurich SRI Lab
Co-founder of DeepCode, ChainSecurity and LatticeFlow
